_readme: The one file to edit. Everything the booking engine says and charges comes from here. Prices are in cents: 8900 is $89.00. A service with "due": 0 takes no payment and becomes a visit request instead. This file is served to the browser, so put nothing private in it; the inbox that receives bookings is the NOTIFY_TO environment variable, not this file.

business.name: Summit Heating & Air
business.tagline: Heating and cooling, fixed the first time.

copy.headline: Book your visit.
copy.sub: Tell us what's going on, pick a time, and hold your spot. Two minutes, and nothing is charged until you confirm.
